To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a constrained optimal control allocation algorithm that minimizes aircraft structural loads can be implemented in a flight control system to reduce the structural loads in a gust.
A framework to incorporate real-time load feedback into a conventional flight control system is developed, and a control allocation algorithm that minimizes structural loads is demonstrated.
A framework for incorporating structural loads in the control allocator is proposed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a framework for the use of structural loads in flight control systems and a control allocation algorithm for optimal structural load alleviation in gusty conditions.
the development and evaluation of a flight control system for a generic transport aircraft.
the development of control allocation algorithms for flight control systems that incorporate structural load measurements and constraints.

the proposed framework for structural loads and the optimal control allocation method are effective for load alleviation and gust load reduction.

a constrained optimal control allocation algorithm can be developed to incorporate structural load feedback in flight control system and can be used for gust load alleviation.

the optimal control allocation algorithm is capable of minimizing the structural load on the aircraft by using the structural loads as the objective function.
the structural loads are not only the function of the flight control system, but also the function of the control allocation algorithm.
